records.command: node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from "node:fs";import path from "node:path";import {ensure,project} from "./src/core.js";let c=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(".dip-local/fixed-host-qa.json"));let d=path.resolve(".dip-local/live-host-output");fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync(path.join(d,"snapshot-2.json"),JSON.stringify(project(ensure(c.root,{instructions:false})),null,2));for(const n of ["prompt-1.txt","prompt-2.txt","turn-1-events.jsonl","turn-1-final.txt","turn-1-stderr.txt","turn-2-events.jsonl","turn-2-final.txt","turn-2-stderr.txt","snapshot-1.json"]){let a=path.join(c.root,n),b=path.join(d,n);if(!fs.statSync(a).isFile()||fs.existsSync(b))throw Error("Unexpected QA path");fs.renameSync(a,b);}console.log("Private earlier transcripts moved outside the QA project.");'
